scope: Sequential local Debug observations on a shared machine; candidate runs overlap real-file E2Es. No causal latency, empty-cache, cloud transport or archive-scale throughput claim.
cache_contract: Projection field-count comparison uses five alternating warm samples after both variants are primed. Controls use three samples per case/cache mode. Process restart retains OS/persistent caches and readiness navigation warming.

candidate.qualification: Production build; 260 targeted native/owner checks and nine stored-column checks passed, one declared benchmark skip, zero leaks; 35 selected real Parquet/Iceberg E2Es passed without skips; 58 paired benchmark pages exactly match full hits and scores.

changes: Hydrate at most 64 winners column-major through an ordinal permutation, preserving public rank and per-row key validation. Five-field projections open five columns per batch rather than per row; cursor capacity stays four.

Source recipe v4 adds authenticated first/last document IDs to trailing chunk directories. Sparse misses open no payload; random seeks decode the selected chunk only. Reusable cursors validate record offsets once and perform binary value lookup; compaction shares these cursors.
Native text builds use retained typed source and allocation-free exact AJV1 sizing instead of a transient full JSON row. Input ownership, segment splitting and resource reservations remain explicit.

Prepared highlight dependencies preserve explicit fields and static source aliases, with complete-source fallback for unknown/dynamic mappings. Covered projected values are reused; hidden fields retain identity checks and final projection hiding.
Merge latest main dictionary-sort, allocator, snapshot and release workflow fixes.

qualification.deterministic_navigation: 32 one-row sparse chunks: cold tail lookup decodes exactly one chunk; a sparse gap adds no decode; sequential traversal adds one decode per selected chunk. Malformed overlapping row ranges fail admission; exhaustive allocation failures pass.
qualification.deterministic_batching: Shuffled winners and five fields preserve exact integers, nested paths, booleans and result positions through append/sorted compaction and deletes. A batch opens five columns and no legacy bodies; exhaustive allocation failures pass.
qualification.deterministic_ingestion: Direct source-column builder retains a 256 KiB typed payload, carries no stored JSON, and preserves byte admission/splitting estimates. Exact AJV1 size matches encoding across scalar/packed/mixed arrays and numeric tokens.
qualification.deterministic_highlights: Prepared static aliases and explicit fields depend only on body; projected body creates fragments without unrelated source values. Unknown schema conservatively requests complete source.

limitations: Nested paths still read the containing top-level typed JSON column.
